desc: Ideation complete: Analyzed the problem as Total Paths in full grid minus Paths intersecting the hole.
Implement modular arithmetic and precompute factorials/inverses for combinations.
Compute Total Paths in full grid $[0,W] \times [0,H]$.
Compute $DP_L[y]$ for $y \in [D, U]$ using inclusion-exclusion on the left boundary.
Compute $DP_B[x]$ for $x \in [L, R]$ using inclusion-exclusion on the bottom boundary.
Calculate the contribution of each first-hit point to the "Bad" paths by multiplying by the number of paths from that point to any valid end $E$.
Subtract Bad from Total to get the answer.
